entities.name: PMID:27497155
observations: Primary study titled “Progranulin is increased in human and murine lipodystrophy.”

entities.name: Human lipodystrophy PGRN increase
observations: In 37 patients versus 37 matched controls, serum progranulin was higher: median 82.9 (IQR 25.9) versus 73.6 (IQR 22.8) μg/L, p=0.005; subtype breakdown was not specified.

entities.name: Murine lipodystrophy PGRN increase
observations: In a lipodystrophy mouse model, progranulin mRNA was significantly increased in visceral, subcutaneous, and brown adipose tissue and muscle versus wild-type; genotype was not specified in the abstract.

entities.name: Metreleptin PGRN unchanged
observations: Among 10 patients with lipodystrophy, circulating progranulin did not change significantly during metreleptin supplementation; CRP was an independent positive predictor.
